name: Landscape Granulator
author: AnimalGuide (ported from Estuary Landscape Granulator v2)
description: 32-voice AXI-SRAM stereo granulator with Tukey windowing, scale-quantized arpeggiator, 4-band LFO-modulated Chamberlin SVF bank, Schroeder/Cloud diffusion, orthonormal tape-warble reverb tank, freeze/overdub gates, and smart mono/stereo input summing.

knobs.name: Grain Size
knobs.description: Grain duration from 80 ms to 750 ms per pass (1.5 s per 2-pass voice) using pow(x, 1.4) curve.

knobs.name: Grain Density
knobs.description: Target grain overlap from 1 to 32 simultaneous voices with equal-power auto-gain.

knobs.name: Arp Reach
knobs.description: Pitch arpeggiator spread across the active scale from -12 to +24 semitones; unison + micro-detune at 0%.

knobs.name: Randomness
knobs.description: Expands playhead time-scatter (20-520 ms), micro-detune (+/-4 to +/-15 cents), octave leaps, and frozen loop window (0.25-2.0 s).

knobs.name: Filter / Diffusion
knobs.description: Sweeps the level-compensated 4-band LFO Chamberlin SVF bank and scales Schroeder/Cloud allpass diffusion.

knobs.name: Reverb Feedback
knobs.description: Stereo tape-warble reverb tank decay time (0.10 to 0.985, up to 20+ s ambient tails).

knobs.name: Verb Mix
knobs.description: Equal-power crossfade between the granular cloud and the diffused reverb tank.

knobs.name: Dry / Wet Mix
knobs.description: Equal-power blend between direct input (mono or true stereo) and the wet granulator/reverb engine (+6 dB wet makeup).

switches.name: Arp Scale
switches.description: Pitch quantization scale: UP=Fifths/Fourths/Octaves, CENTER=Pentatonic/Add9, DOWN=Dual-LFO Octave + Just Intonation.

switches.name: Grain Direction
switches.description: Grain playback direction chosen at spawn: UP=Forward, CENTER=50% Random Forward/Reverse, DOWN=Reverse.

cv_inputs.name: Size CV
cv_inputs.description: Bipolar CV modulation for Grain Size (+/-50%).

cv_inputs.name: Density CV
cv_inputs.description: Bipolar CV modulation for Grain Density (+/-50%).

cv_inputs.name: Arp CV
cv_inputs.description: Bipolar CV modulation for Arp Reach (+/-50%).

cv_inputs.name: Space Swell CV
cv_inputs.description: Bipolar CV simultaneously modulating Filter/Diffusion (+/-35%) and Reverb Feedback (+/-50%).

gate_inputs.name: Freeze
gate_inputs.description: Freezes the 2.0 s buffer while HIGH and loops a slice sized by Randomness (takes priority over Overdub).

gate_inputs.name: Overdub
gate_inputs.description: Engages 95% continuous loop overdub with asymptotic saturation while HIGH (and Freeze is LOW).

gate_outputs.name: Freeze Active
gate_outputs.description: High when Freeze gate is active.

gate_outputs.name: Overdub Active
gate_outputs.description: High when Overdub gate is active.
